description: Add the normalized RCS profile contract, safe image validation, deterministic fallback profiles, unconditional RCS profile reachability, renderer/editor/store behavior, and focused component/schema tests.
steps: Update src/schema/flow.ts validators and rcsProfileSchema defaults/invariants; add focused rejection and fallback-contract tests.
Create src/channels/rcs/profile.ts with authored precedence and deterministic .example fallback contacts.
Normalize all RCS headers and route every RCS brand through RcsBusinessProfileView while preserving the WhatsApp branch.
Refactor RcsBusinessProfileView to render normalized identity/banner/details/controls without hard-coded brand copy.
Handle rejected BrandEditor FileReader reads and add banner-aware validated store patch persistence while preserving flow-owned rcsProfile.
Run focused unit/component/store validation and record evidence in findings.
acceptance_criteria: A brand without rcsProfile opens an RCS Info & options view with deterministic reserved .example contacts and a neutral/shared banner.
Authored profile fields take precedence, shared banner/verified fields are projected, and both authored/fallback headers omit video and call buttons.
Unsafe image sources and invalid gallery count combinations are rejected while valid app-relative, HTTPS, and bounded editor image data are accepted.
V Bank/profile-specific hard-coded Romain, Vonage, pizza, and demo content is absent from the renderer, and WhatsApp rendering remains generic.
verification: npx vitest run src/channels/rcs/profile.test.ts src/components/phone/RcsBusinessProfileView.test.tsx src/components/phone/BusinessProfileView.test.tsx src/channels/rcs/RcsHeader.test.tsx src/store/simulatorStore.test.ts
findings: Implemented normalized RCS profile fallback/authored precedence in src/channels/rcs/profile.ts; fallback contacts use deterministic .example domains, support mailboxes, and reserved +1 202 555 01## numbers. Added safeExternalUrl, safeImageSource, safeEditorImageSource, gallery defaults/invariants, and focused schema rejection coverage in src/schema/flow.ts and src/schema/flow.test.ts. RCS headers now always normalize and expose back/more only; all RCS profile overlays route through the normalized renderer while WhatsApp remains unchanged. Renderer has dynamic banner/identity/contacts/gallery/policy controls with neutral fallback and no hard-coded profile copy. BrandEditor catches FileReader rejection with the stable toast; store accepts banner patches and preserves flow-owned rcsProfile.
